reason: Practitioner overview contrasting chatbots and AI agents in sales support: use-case selection and deployment considerations, no primary method or study.
LLM multi-agent framework for power-electronics controller design; the claim is an autonomous domain design process, with no evidence about the workflow itself.
Casidence agentic medical VLM; reported claims are retrieval fidelity, report quality and planning transparency over baselines, i.e. task outcomes.
MINDS multi-agent mining decision support; evidence is request-to-report orchestration, 10.69 s debate latency and an audit trail on the Marvin benchmark.
AeroAgent embodied LMM drone agent with ROSchain; claims are superior search-and-rescue performance against DRL agents, not about its control loop.
mAIstro master-plus-task-agent medical imaging pipeline; evaluation is whether tasks executed correctly on 16 datasets, a task outcome.
k-agents turns lab procedures into agent state machines, but the reported evidence is autonomous quantum-processor calibration at human level, a task outcome.
Audio-Mind gates tool-based evidence acquisition on unresolved evidence gaps; matched-backbone comparison shows agentic decomposition as an orchestration bottleneck. Mechanism: iteration policy.
AgentSUMO adds an adaptive reasoning layer for SUMO scenario generation, but the reported gains are traffic-flow metrics and non-expert accessibility.
IoA platform adds dynamic teaming and conversation flow control, yet the evidence is beating baselines on assistant, embodied and RAG benchmarks.
MiroFlow agent framework with an agent graph and deep reasoning mode; claims are SOTA scores on GAIA, BrowseComp, HLE, xBench and FutureX.
Conceptual blueprint and reference architecture for agentic enterprise systems, synthesising quantitative evidence reported from existing deployments.
Paper Debugger multi-agent Overleaf extension; evidence is 34% less manual formatting time and a SUS of 78.4, i.e. task and usability outcomes.
BayesBeliefAgent interrupts a running skill only when partner actions contradict the inferred skill, measuring replanning efficiency and belief-action gap. Mechanism: iteration policy.
FlowBench benchmarks workflow-knowledge formats for agent planning; it measures planning quality, not a loop property such as retries, stuck loops or termination.
Review of 126 papers on LLMs in automated planning and scheduling, categorising applications and gaps.
RePLan uses VLM grounding to detect that a plan failed and replans online; tested on an eight-task RC benchmark against baselines that cannot adapt. Mechanism: retry/repair.
Diagnoses step-wise greedy choice as the long-horizon failure mode; FLARE adds lookahead and limited commitment, evaluated on planning-level behaviour. Mechanism: iteration policy.
ALAS isolates the validator from the planner and repairs locally; a reliability study measures fault detection overhead and edit radius versus global recompute. Mechanism: verification, retry/repair.
TAIRA recommender multi-agent with thought-pattern distillation; claims are recommendation performance across datasets and harder user intents.
GoalAct adds continuously updated global planning and hierarchical execution but reports only LegalAgentBench success rate, +12.22%, a task outcome.
LLMCompiler replaces ReAct's sequential reason-act cycle with a planner, task fetcher and parallel executor, measured as latency, cost and accuracy against ReAct. Mechanism: iteration policy.
Voice-to-action system wires an off-the-shelf LLM planner to a robot skill library; results are component-level seeking, navigation and manipulation performance.
Curriculum over a 64x64 agent grid with a Thompson sampling manager; claims are stability, oracle usage and reasoning on a Tower of Hanoi benchmark.
Formalises a design space for human-LLM co-planning and benchmarks how LLMs revise plans under varying scope and revision strategy. Mechanism: iteration policy, plan revision.
Hierarchical LTLf grounding with a receding-horizon replanning loop for multi-robot handover; claims are success rate and interaction fluency on robots.
OSDAG invokes the LLM once to emit a dependency DAG; the iterating component is a classical online scheduler over robots, not a language-model control loop.
The loop under study is an RL controller's MDP; the LLM only supplies a potential-based progress score, with policy invariance proved on a small MDP.
TreeSoc runs DFS decomposition with tool routing for soccer video QA, but the reported claims are SoccerBench and NExT-QA accuracy, not the search mechanism.
Lightweight LLM human-in-the-loop multi-robot system; evidence is unquantified improvements with 12 simulated TurtleBot3 robots and easier deployment.
Review of agentic AI architectures, coordination mechanisms and frameworks, with a CrewAI/LangChain/LangGraph case study and gains quoted from the literature.
Study of an agentic LLM as the core robot controller: reports memory-guided replanning, execution recovery and hallucinated task success. Mechanism: loop state, termination.
Thesis parses language once into an action sequence; the replanning trigger is a 5cm object displacement in the scene graph, with no language-model control loop.
TeleCom-Bench evaluates telecom knowledge and end-to-end workflow tasks; it measures execution accuracy across LLMs, not any loop property.
S1-NexusAgent dual-loop self-evolving research agent; the claims are SOTA results on biomini-eval, ChemBench and MatSciBench.
ReflectVLN triggers reflection when the execution agent emits deviation signals, reporting fewer high-level intention calls alongside recovery. Mechanism: retry/repair, triggering.
ALRM wires an off-the-shelf ReAct-style loop into robotic manipulation plus a new benchmark; results rank ten LLMs by task success.
DaDu-E closed-loop embodied planner with feedback and memory; claims are task success comparable to larger planners at 6.6x lower compute.
Conceptual theorising of agentic SDLC workflows from 30 prior papers, with SWE-bench and HumanEval numbers quoted from the literature.
VLM-guided horticultural robot planning framework; results are crop-monitoring success rates and degradation under noisy semantic maps.
PivoARL retries only from the pivotal erroneous turn instead of a full retry, cutting interaction turns about 42% versus full-retry methods. Mechanism: retry/repair.
VerifyMAS verifies failure hypotheses over finished trajectories; a fine-tuned attribution verifier scored on attribution accuracy, with no runtime loop.
AgenTracer trains a post-hoc failure tracer via counterfactual replay and fault injection; claims are attribution accuracy and downstream task gains, no loop of its own.
AFANet is a GNN classifier over completed multi-agent trajectories for failure attribution; no runtime loop, evaluated on attribution accuracy and cost.
Citation failure in single-pass RAG generation; CITECONTROL benchmark and CITENTION combine generative, attention and retrieval citation methods, no iterative control.
